intro.title: The treble clef
intro.text: The curly sign at the start is the treble clef. It's for higher notes, usually your right hand. Each line and space is one white key, stepping up as you go up.

intro.title: C on the staff
intro.text: Middle C sits on its own short line below the staff, a ledger line.

intro.title: D on the staff
intro.text: D hangs just under the bottom line.

intro.title: E on the staff
intro.text: E sits on the bottom line. Line, space, line: one step each.
